text:
sam: quick thread  i'm drafting the whatsnew blurb for tomorrow. key items: fallback routing snippet, streaming-embeddings truncation >4MB, one redirect, and a tiny sdk example fix. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4522

maria: thanks. keep the whatsnew as 3 machine-friendly bullets (short, factual). avoid marketing words.

olivia: pushed a tiny fix to the python example in examples/python/generate.py (stop token handling).

dan: added a 3-line node snippet for the whatsnew box. posting here for preview:
```js
// minimal fallback routing
const c = new Redwood(process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY)
await c.generate({ model: 'redwood-kitefish-v1', fallbacks: ['redwood-kitefish-v1-quant','gpt-compatible-fallback'] })
```

maria: add a one-line parenthetical after the snippet: (Quantized fallback may tokenize differently; verify prompt & stop tokens). also link to quantization guide.

olivia: found a 404 in rollout docs (/docs/dedicated/autoscale). filed PR #4523 to add a redirect to /docs/dedicated/scaling. mark under Known issues as "redirect in progress".

docs-bot: reminder  staging deploy scheduled for tomorrow 09:00 UTC after signoff.

sam: timeline  i'll update the PR tonight, request LGTM by 07:00 UTC, run local docsite build, and smoke-test examples.

maria: LGTM from me after the parenthetical and redirect note are added. i'll squash & merge once green and ping when staging is live. :rocket:
